input.command: cd /workspace/inventory && cat TODO.md 2>/dev/null; echo "---GIT---"; git status --short 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---LOG---"; git log --oneline -5 2>&1

cd /workspace/inventory && for f in src/inventory/report.py src/inventory/stock.py src/inventory/pricing.py src/inventory/__init__.py tests/test_report.py tests/test_stock.py tests/test_pricing.py tests/conftest.py pyproject.toml README.md CHANGELOG.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done
cd /workspace/inventory && ls -la && echo "===GNOMON TREE===" && find .gnomon -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50
cd /workspace/inventory && for f in .gnomon/*.toml .gnomon/system.md .gnomon/skills/*.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done; echo "=== .env ==="; cat .env; echo "=== var ==="; ls -la var

cd /workspace/inventory && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== non-empty report ==="; python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from inventory.stock import Stock
from inventory.report import render_report
s=Stock(); s.add('widget',4); s.add('gadget',2)
print(render_report(s))
print('--- empty ---')
print(render_report(Stock()))
"

cd /workspace/inventory && git diff --stat && echo "=== implement role write scope ===" && grep -n "write_allow\|^\[roles.implement\]\|tools =" .gnomon/roles.toml | head -20 && echo "=== policy verify block ===" && grep -n "test_must_fail_first\|^\[verify\]\|^command\|^after\|^max_rounds" .gnomon/policy.toml && echo "=== docs dir? ===" && ls -d docs specs 2>&1
